_comment: What tools/check-news.py reads every morning. Edit this rather than the script when you want a new source or a new search. A feed marked "filter": true is too broad to print whole, so only items naming a beat term survive; the narrow feeds are already on our beat and print in full.

queries.label: Chemical suits over consumer goods
queries.q: lawsuit (phthalates OR benzene OR "heavy metals") (cosmetics OR sunscreen OR baby OR shampoo)

queries.label: Greenwashing suits
queries.q: "false advertising" lawsuit ("non-toxic" OR "plastic free" OR "clean beauty")

queries.label: Metals and plastics recalls
queries.q: recall (lead OR cadmium OR phthalates) (children OR toys OR kitchen OR cookware)

queries.label: Reformulations and launches
queries.q: ("PFAS free" OR "phthalate free" OR "plastic free") (launches OR launch OR reformulated OR "new line")

queries.label: Regulation on our beat
queries.q: (ban OR restricts OR "new rule") (PFAS OR phthalates OR bisphenol OR "flame retardants") (products OR packaging)

research.label: Microplastics in people
research.q: (microplastic* OR nanoplastic*) AND (human OR blood OR placenta OR "breast milk" OR infant OR "drinking water" OR "bottled water")

research.label: Food contact chemicals
research.q: (phthalate* OR bisphenol* OR "food contact") AND (packaging OR migration OR "food simulant" OR diet)

research.label: PFAS in products
research.q: (PFAS OR polyfluoroalkyl) AND (textile* OR cosmetic* OR packaging OR "consumer product*" OR "drinking water")

research.label: Metals in consumer goods
research.q: ("lead exposure" OR "lead contamination" OR "lead levels" OR "heavy metal*" OR cadmium OR arsenic) AND (toy* OR cosmetic* OR "baby food" OR ceramic OR dinnerware OR spice* OR "consumer product*")

research.label: Flame retardants in the home
research.q: ("flame retardant*" OR "organophosphate ester*") AND (furniture OR textile* OR "car seat*" OR mattress* OR dust)
